subject: Trailer Landing Gear Assembly Welds May Fail
defect_summary: Great Dane Trailers (Great Dane) is recalling certain 2027 Champion and Everest van trailers. The trailer landing gear k-brace welds may fail, resulting in the landing gear collapsing.
consequence_summary: A trailer landing gear that collapses increases the risk of injury.
corrective_action: Great Dane will inspect and replace the landing gear k-brace as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 22, 2026. Owners may contact Great Dane's customer service at 1-877-369-3493.

subject: Wheelchair Lift May Inadvertently Move
defect_summary: BYD Coach & Bus (BYD) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Ride Type A school buses. The electrical contactor may fail, preventing the controls from stopping the lift.
consequence_summary: A wheelchair lift that continues to move while occupied increases the risk of injury.
corrective_action: BYD will work with Ricon to correct the wiring by installing two diodes, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 21, 2026.  Owners may contact BYD customer service at 1-661-940-3250. BYD's number for this recall is CAMP-082826-1105.

subject: Tail lights May Fail/FMVSS 108
defect_summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain MOPAR tail lights with part numbers 68272126AC, and 68272127AC. The terminals in the tail light wiring harness may be damaged and cause the tail lights to fail. As such, this equipment fails to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."
consequence_summary: Tail lights that fail to illuminate properly reduce the vehicle's visibility to other drivers, increasing the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Dealers will inspect and replace the tail light assemblies, as necessary, free of charge. Dealers will repurchase uninstalled tail light assemblies. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 3, 2026. Owners may contact Chrysler customer service at 800-853-1403. Chrysler's number for this recall is A3D.

subject: Tail lights May Fail/FMVSS 108
defect_summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2026 Dodge Durango vehicles. The terminals in the tail light wiring harness may be damaged and cause the tail lights to fail. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."
consequence_summary: Tail lights that fail to illuminate properly reduce the vehicle's visibility to other drivers, increasing the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Dealers will inspect and replace the tail light assemblies, as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 3, 2026. Owners may contact Chrysler customer service at 800-853-1403. Chrysler's number for this recall is A2D. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will become searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning October 29, 2026.

subject: Incorrect Spare Tire Information on Tire Placard/FMVSS 110
defect_summary: Nissan North America, Inc. (Nissan) is recalling certain spare tire accessory kits, part number T99MB7SF0A, sold for certain 2026 Sentra vehicles. The spare tire size and inflation information on the tire placard is incorrect. As such, vehicles equipped with these kits fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 110, "Tire Selection and Rims."
consequence_summary: Incorrect spare tire pressure information on the placard may lead to incorrect inflation of the spare tire, increasing the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Nissan will mail corrected tire information placards, free of charge. Owners may bring the labels into a dealer for free installation. Owner notification letters were mailed November 13, 2026. Owners may contact Nissan's customer service at 800-647-7261. Nissan's number for this recall is PD208.

subject: Fuel Filter Hoses May Disconnect and Leak Fuel
defect_summary: PACCAR Incorporated (PACCAR) is recalling certain 2022-2023 Kenworth T370, T270, 2022-2027 Kenworth T280, Peterbilt 548, 2023-2027 Kenworth T480, T380, Peterbilt 536, 537, and 2025 Peterbilt 567 vehicles. The remote fuel filter hoses may separate from the fitting, causing a fuel leak and an engine stall.
consequence_summary: A fuel leak in the presence of an ignition source increases the risk of a fire. An engine stall increases the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Dealers will replace the fuel hoses, free of charge. Owner notification letters will be mailed beginning December 20, 2026. Owners may contact Peterbilt's customer service at 1-940-591-4220 or Kenworth's customer service at 1-425-828-5888. PACCAR's number for this recall is 26PACJ.

subject: Fuel Filter Hoses May Disconnect and Leak Fuel
defect_summary: Autocar, LLC (Autocar) is recalling certain 2022-2027 ACX (Xpeditor) vehicles equipped with Cummins L9 diesel engines, part number D563027BX03. The remote fuel filter hoses may separate from the fitting, causing a fuel leak and an engine stall.
consequence_summary: A fuel leak in the presence of an ignition source increases the risk of a fire. An engine stall increases the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Cummins will replace the fuel hoses, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 17, 2026. Owners may contact Cummins customer service at 1-800-286-6467 or Autocar customer service at 1-888-218-3611. Cummins number for this recall is C7311. Autocar's number for this recall is ACX-2603.

subject: High Voltage Battery May Catch Fire
defect_summary: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Audi) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Q4 E-Tron and Q4 Sportback E-Tron vehicles. The high voltage battery may fail and cause a fire.
consequence_summary: A vehicle fire increases the risk of injury.
corrective_action: Owners are advised to only charge their vehicles to a maximum of 80% capacity until the repair has been completed. The remedy is currently under development. Interim letters notifying owners of the safety risk are expected to be mailed December 18, 2026. Additional letters will be sent once the remedy is available. Owners may contact Audi customer service at 1-800-253-2834. Audi's number for this recall is 93SK. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on October 23, 2026.

subject: Heater Hose May Rupture and Leak
defect_summary: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain Thomas Built Buses 2027 Saf-T-Liner C2 school buses. The heater hose may rupture, which can result in hot coolant leaking inside the passenger compartment.
consequence_summary: Contact with hot coolant may burn occupants, increasing the risk of injury.
corrective_action: Dealers will inspect and replace the heater hose as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 18, 2026. Owners may contact DTNA customer service at 1-800-547-0712. DTNA's number for this recall is F1043.

subject: Unintended Vehicle Movement from Disengaged Electronic Parking Brake
defect_summary: Koenigsegg Automotive AB (Koenigsegg) is recalling certain 2025-2026 CC850 vehicles. The electronic parking brake may not engage properly when the vehicle is in reverse, allowing in unintended vehicle movement.
consequence_summary: Unintended vehicle movement increases the risk of a crash or injury.
corrective_action: The parking brake control software will be updated over-the-air (OTA) or by a dealer, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected be mailed October 29, 2026. Owners may contact Koenigsegg's customer service at 703-712-8324.

subject: Wheel May Detach
defect_summary: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2026 Venue, Elantra N, Elantra Hybrid, and Elantra vehicles. The wheel lug nuts may loosen and allow the wheel to detach.
consequence_summary: Wheel detachment can cause a loss of vehicle control or create a road hazard, increasing the risk of a crash or injury.
corrective_action: Dealers will inspect and tighten the wheel assembly lug nuts, and replace the hub bearing assembly, as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 19, 2026. Owners may contact Hyundai customer service at 1-855-371-9460. Hyundai's number for this recall is 310. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will become searchable on NHTSA.gov on October 23, 2026.

subject: Loss of Steering Control From Loose Fasteners
defect_summary: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2026 Tucson Hybrid and Elantra vehicles. The front strut assembly fasteners may not be tightened properly, which can result in a loss of vehicle steering control.
consequence_summary: A loss of vehicle steering control increases the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Dealers will inspect and replace the front strut assembly fasteners and perform a wheel alignment, as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 19, 2026. Owners may contact Hyundai customer service at 1-855-371-9460. Hyundai's number for this recall is 309. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will become searchable on NHTSA.gov on October 23, 2026.

subject: Trailer Landing Gear Assembly Welds May Fail
defect_summary: Great Dane Trailers (Great Dane) is recalling certain landing gear assemblies with part number A30300240001. The trailer landing gear k-brace welds may fail, resulting in the landing gear collapsing.
consequence_summary: A trailer landing gear that collapses increases the risk of injury.
corrective_action: Great Dane will inspect and replace the landing gear k-brace as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 18, 2026. Owners may contact Great Dane's customer service at 1-877-369-3493.

subject: Seat Back May Unlatch During Crash
defect_summary: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2022-2026 Sienna Hybrid  7-passenger vehicles. The second-row seat backs may fail to remain secured in the event of a crash.
consequence_summary: A seat back that is not secured may fail to properly protect an occupant during a crash, increasing the risk of injury.
corrective_action: Dealers will update the supplemental restraint system (SRS) electronic control unit (ECU) software. For vehicles equipped with the "Mobility as a Service" (MaaS) package, dealers will replace the two second-row seat backs. Repairs will be performed free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 7, 2026. Owners may contact Toyota's customer service at 1-800-331-4331. Toyota's numbers for this recall are 26TB24 and 26TA24.

subject: Tailgate Cable May Fail
defect_summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2026-2027 F-150, 2026 F-250 SD, F-350 SD, and F-450 SD vehicles. The left-side tailgate cable may fail under certain heavy load conditions.
consequence_summary: Tailgate cable failure may allow the tailgate to drop onto the rear bumper, increasing the risk of injury.
corrective_action: Dealers will replace the left-side tailgate cable, free of charge. Interim letters, notifying owners of the safety risk, are expected to be mailed December 14, 2026. Additional letters will be sent once the remedy is available, anticipated in January 2027. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332. Ford's number for this recall is 26S78. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will be searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning December 7, 2026.

subject: Loss of Drive Power from Unexpected Shift to Neutral
defect_summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2026-2027 Nautilus Hybrid and 2027 Corsair Hybrid vehicles. The vehicle may unexpectedly shift into neutral while driving, due to corrosion in the transmission's park lock actuator circuit board.
consequence_summary: A vehicle that unexpectedly shifts into neutral can lead to a sudden loss of drive power, increasing the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Dealers will replace the Integrated Park Module (IPM), free of charge. Interim letters, notifying owners of the safety risk, are expected to be mailed November 2, 2026. Additional letters will be sent once the remedy is available. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332. Ford's number for this recall is 26S75. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on October 26, 2026.

subject: Instrument Panel Display Failure/FMVSS 101
defect_summary: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2022-2024 Lexus  NX250, NX350, NX350 Hybrid, and NX450h+ vehicles. The instrument panel cluster combination meter may fail to display certain warnings or indicators. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 101, "Control and Displays."
consequence_summary: An instrument panel display that fails to show engine oil pressure, engine coolant temperature, or electrical charge increases the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Dealers will update the combination meter software, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 7, 2026. Owners may contact Toyota's customer service at 1-800-331-4331. Toyota's number for this recall is 26LA10.

subject: Replacement ABS Module May Be Incorrectly Programmed
defect_summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain Anti-Lock Brake System (ABS) modules with part number EB5Z-2C219-B, DB5Z-2C219-B, CB5Z-2C219-C, DL1Z-2C219-A, or DT4Z-2C219-B. The replacement ABS module may be programmed with the incorrect software, preventing the ABS from functioning as intended.
consequence_summary: An incorrectly programmed ABS may cause a loss of ABS and degrade brake balance, increasing the distance needed to stop and the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Dealers will inspect and replace the ABS module as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 30, 2026. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332. Ford's number for this recall is 26S76.

subject: Solar Panel Wiring May Be Loose
defect_summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2023-2026 Pause travel trailers. The incorrect connector was used to secure the 12 volt solar panel wires.
consequence_summary: A loose wire may increase the risk of a fire.
corrective_action: Dealers will install a new connector, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 28, 2026. Owners may contact Forest River customer service at 1-574-535-2748. Forest River's number for this recall is 426-2107.

subject: Do Not Drive: Loss of Vehicle Control
defect_summary: Subaru of America, Inc. (Subaru) is recalling certain 2026 Crosstrek and Forester vehicles. The castle nut on the left-front lower control arm ball joint may be improperly fastened, which can lead to the ball joint separating from the lower control arm.
consequence_summary: A ball joint that separates from the lower control arm can cause a loss of vehicle control, increasing the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Owners are advised not to drive their vehicle until the remedy is completed. Dealers will inspect and replace the left-front lower control arm ball joint assembly, as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 16, 2026.  Owners may contact Subaru customer service at 1-844-373-6614.  Subaru's number for this recall is WRI26.

subject: Backer Material May Be Insufficient to Secure Refrigerator In Place
defect_summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2026-2027 Campsite Reserve travel trailers. The backer material to secure the refrigerator in place may fail.
consequence_summary: An unsecured refrigerator may move or tip over during transit, increases the risk of injury.
corrective_action: Dealers will install more backer material, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 28, 2026. Owners may contact Forest River customer service at 1-260-499-2100. Forest River's number for this recall is 62-2106.

subject: Incorrect Wheel Bearing Lubrication
defect_summary: Wabash National Corporation (Wabash) is recalling certain 2027 Van Trailers. Incorrect wheel bearing lubricant may cause the wheel end to seize, which can result in wheel lock-up.
consequence_summary: Wheel lock-up can result in a loss of vehicle handling and control, increasing the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Dealers will inspect and replace the wheel bearing lubrication as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 25, 2026. Owners may contact Wabash customer service at 1-765-771-5404.

subject: Do Not Drive: Center Lock May Break Causing Wheel Detachment
defect_summary: Porsche Cars North America, Inc. (Porsche) is recalling certain 2024 718 Cayman GT4 RS, 911 Turbo S, 911 Turbo, 911 S/T, 911 GT3 RS, 911 GT3, 911 Carrera GTS, and 718 Spyder RS vehicles. The center lock wheel bolt may fracture and cause the wheel to detach.
consequence_summary: Wheel detachment can result in a loss of vehicle control, increasing the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Owners are advised not to drive their vehicles until they have been repaired. Dealers will check the center lock wheel fastening system and replace any incorrectly manufactured parts, as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 15, 2026. Owners may contact Porsche customer service at 1-800-767-7243. Porsche's number for this recall is ATA1. This recall expands previous NHTSA recall number 24V809. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on October 20, 2026.

subject: Slide Switch May Be Missing Overcurrent Protection
defect_summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2026-2027 Cedar Creek recreational trailers. The slide switch may have been installed without proper overcurrent protection.
consequence_summary: A unprotected slide switch can cause the wire to overheat, increasing the risk of a fire.
corrective_action: Dealers will re-route the 12V slide switch wiring, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 15, 2026. Owners may contact Forest River customer service at 1-260-593-4000. Forest River's number for this recall is 20-2105.

subject: Seating Power Cord May Have Inadequate Circuit Protection
defect_summary: Alliance RV, LLC (Alliance) is recalling certain 2025-2027 Valor and 2026-2027 Delta recreational trailers equipped with certain power seating assemblies. The power cord fuse may not provide adequate circuit protection.
consequence_summary: In the event of a short circuit, inadequate protection increases the risk of a fire.
corrective_action: Dealers will replace the power cord, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 7, 2026. Owners may contact Alliance customer service at 1-574-218-7165.

subject: Fuel Filter Hoses May Disconnect and Leak Fuel
defect_summary: Shyft Group (Shyft) is recalling certain 2024-2027 Spartan RV Chassis K2 vehicles. The remote fuel filter hoses may separate from the fitting, causing a fuel leak and an engine stall.
consequence_summary: A fuel leak in the presence of an ignition source increases the risk of a fire. An engine stall increases the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Cummins will replace the fuel hoses, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 20, 2026. Owners may contact Cummins customer service at 1-800-286-6467 or Shyft customer service at 1-855-589-9836. Cummins number for this recall is C7311. Shyft's number for this recall is 26-07.

subject: Loose or Missing Structural Bolts in Sleeper Cab
defect_summary: Volvo Trucks North America (Volvo Trucks) is recalling certain replacement sleeper cabs, model VNL660 with part number 78785681, and model VNL860 with part number 78785689. The sleeper cabs may have loose or missing structural bolts.
consequence_summary: A sleeper cab with loose or missing structural bolts may not properly protect an occupant during a crash, increasing the risk of injury.
corrective_action: Dealers will inspect for missing structural bolts and install and/or tighten the bolts, as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 14, 2026. Owners may contact Volvo Trucks' customer service at 800-528-6586. Volvo Trucks' number for this recall is RVXX2613.

subject: Loose or Missing Structural Bolts in Truck Cab
defect_summary: Volvo Trucks North America (Volvo Trucks) is recalling certain 2025-2026 VNL (4) vehicles. The truck cabs may have loose or missing structural bolts.
consequence_summary: A cab with loose or missing structural bolts may not properly protect an occupant during a crash, increasing the risk of injury.
corrective_action: Dealers will inspect for missing structural bolts and install and/or tighten the bolts, as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 14, 2026. Owners may contact Volvo Trucks' customer service at 800-528-6586. Volvo Trucks' number for this recall is RVXX2612. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on October 22, 2026.

manufacturer: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC
subject: Water May Damage Rearview Camera
defect_summary: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC (Land Rover) is recalling certain 2022-2026 Land Rover Range Rover vehicles. Water may not be able to drain away from the rearview camera due to insufficient drain holes, which may result in damage to the rearview camera.
consequence_summary: A rearview camera image that does not display can reduce the driver's view behind the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Dealers will drill additional drain holes in the underside of the tailgate trim. Additionally, dealers will inspect and replace the rearview camera as necessary. Repairs will be performed free of charge. Interim letters notifying owners of the safety risk are expected to be mailed December 11, 2026. Additional letters will be sent once the final remedy is available. Owners may contact Land Rover's customer service at 800-637-6837. Land Rover's number for this recall is D171.

subject: Missing Emergency Exit Label/FMVSS 217
defect_summary: Prevost Car (US) Inc. (Prevost) is recalling certain Prevost buses. Please see the above list of models. The entrance door is missing the emergency exit operating instruction label. As such, these vehicles fail to conform to Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 217, "Bus Emergency Exits and Window Retention and Release."
consequence_summary: Missing instructions may prevent or delay passengers from evacuating the bus during an emergency, increasing the risk of injury.
corrective_action: Prevost will replace the emergency exit label, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 7, 2026. Owners may contact Prevost's customer service at 1-866-870-2046. Prevost's number for this recall is SR26-19.

subject: Bunk Restraint Webbing Not Secured Properly
defect_summary: PACCAR Incorporated (PACCAR) is recalling certain 2027 Peterbilt 567, 579, 589, Kenworth T680, T880, W900, and W990 vehicles. The belt restraint webbing for the sleeper bunk was not secured properly during manufacturing.
consequence_summary: A bunk restraint with improperly secured webbing may fail to adequately restrain vehicle occupants during a crash, increasing the risk of injury.
corrective_action: Dealers will inspect and replace the bunk restraints, as necessary, free of charge.  Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 13, 2026.  Owners may contact Kenworth's customer service at 1-425-828-5888 and Peterbilt's customer service at 1-940-591-4220.  PACCAR's number for this recall is 26PACH.

subject: Loss of Steering Control
defect_summary: KTM North American, Inc. (KTM) is recalling certain Müller Präzision steering dampers (part number 16181T01E) sold as accessory parts for certain 2020-2026 KTM Super Duke R and Super Duke Evo motorcycles. The steering damper can loosen from the mounting adapter, which can lead to a loss of steering control.
consequence_summary: Loss of steering control increases the risk of a crash or injury.
corrective_action: Dealers will apply thread locker to the steering damper and tighten properly, free of charge. KTM notified dealers on October 13, 2026. Owners may contact KTM customer service at 1-888-985-6090.  The information in your report suggests that KTM North America, Inc. may have been aware of this issue more than five business days before filing a report with NHTSA. Please be reminded that under Federal law, this agency is to be notified of all safety defect and/or noncompliance decisions within five business days. 49 CFR 573.6 Significant civil penalties can be assessed for this violation.

subject: Fuel Tubes May Disconnect and Leak
defect_summary: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2024-2027 Toyota Land Cruiser Hybrid vehicles. The fuel tube connection near the fuel tank may disconnect and leak fuel.
consequence_summary: A fuel leak in the presence of an ignition source can increase the risk of a fire.
corrective_action: Dealers will inspect the connection and install a supplemental clamp or, as necessary, replace the resin fuel tube and install a supplemental clamp, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 29, 2026. Owners may contact Toyota's customer service at 1-800-331-4331. Toyota's numbers for this recall are 26TB23 and 26TA23.

subject: Missing Circuit Protection on Charge Line
defect_summary: K.Z., Inc. (K.Z.) is recalling certain 2026-2027 SportTrek Fifth Wheel recreational trailers. The charge line may not have circuit protection.
consequence_summary: An unprotected charge line can cause the wire to overheat, increasing the risk of a fire.
corrective_action: Dealers will inspect and reconfigure the wiring as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 12, 2026. Owners may contact K.Z. customer service at 1-800-768-4016 ext. 154 or 153. K.Z.'s number for this recall is KZ-2026-02.

subject: Fuel Filter Hoses May Disconnect and Leak Fuel
defect_summary: Temsa is recalling certain 2024-2025 TS35 coaches. The remote fuel filter hoses may separate from the fitting, causing a fuel leak and an engine stall.
consequence_summary: A fuel leak in the presence of an ignition source increases the risk of a fire. An engine stall increases the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Cummins dealers will replace the fuel hoses, free of charge.  Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 19, 2026. Owners may contact Cummins customer service at 1-800-286-6467 or Temsa customer service at 1-833-628-3672.

subject: Incorrect Tire Size and Pressure Information on Label/FMVSS 110
defect_summary: Grand Design RV, LLC (Grand Design) is recalling certain 2027 Transcend travel trailers. The tire information label may state the incorrect tire size and cold inflation pressure. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 110, "Tire Selection and Rims."
consequence_summary: Referencing incorrect information can result in installing the wrong size replacement tires or underinflating the tires, increasing the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Dealers will replace the labels, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 19, 2026. Owners may contact Grand Design customer service at 1-574-825-9679. Grand Design's number for this recall is 910070.

subject: Safety Chains Are Underrated For GVWR
defect_summary: Grand Design RV, LLC (Grand Design) is recalling certain 2026-2027 Imagine travel trailers. The installed safety chains are underrated for the Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR).
consequence_summary: Underrated chains can allow the trailer to detach from the tow vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Dealers will replace the safety chains, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 19, 2026. Owners may contact Grand Design customer service at 1-574-825-9679. Grand Design's number for this recall is 910069.

subject: Seating Power Cord May Have Inadequate Circuit Protection
defect_summary: Lippert is recalling certain power seating assemblies. The power cord fuse may not provide adequate circuit protection.
consequence_summary: In the event of a short circuit, inadequate protection increases the risk of a fire.
corrective_action: Dealers will replace the power cord, free of charge. The notification schedule has not yet been provided. Owners may contact Lippert customer service at 1-574-538-4514.

subject: Head Restraint Cushion May Detach
defect_summary: Volvo Car USA, LLC (Volvo Car) is recalling certain 2025-2026 EX30 and 2026 EX30CC vehicles. The head restraint cushion may detach during a crash.
consequence_summary: A detached head restraint cushion can increase the risk of injury during a crash.
corrective_action: Dealers will apply an adhesive to reinforce the head cushion attachment, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 30, 2026. Owners may contact Volvo Car’s customer service at 1-800-458-1552. Volvo Car’s number for this recall is R10396. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on October 9, 2026.

subject: Missing Rearview Camera
defect_summary: Altec Industries, Inc. (Altec) is recalling certain 2026 Service Body, Aerial Device, Digger Derrick, and AC Series Crane vehicles. These vehicles may have been manufactured without a rearview camera installed.
consequence_summary: A missing rearview camera can reduce the driver's view behind the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Altec will install a camera or provide a camera kit to owners as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters will be mailed December 4, 2026. Owners may contact Altec customer service at 1-877-462-5832. Altec's number for this recall is CSN-3376.

subject: Front Bumper May Detach
defect_summary: Altec Industries, Inc. (Altec) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Digger Derrick vehicles. The front winch bumper may be secured with incorrect bolts, which can cause the bumper to detach from the vehicle.
consequence_summary: A front bumper that detaches can become a road hazard and increase the risk of a crash. In addition, the bolts can fail suddenly during winch operation, increasing the risk of injury.
corrective_action: Altec will install the correct bolts on the front bumper, free of charge. Owner notification letters will be mailed December 4, 2026. Owners may contact Altec customer service at 1-877-462-5832. Altec's number for this recall is CSN-3375.

subject: Park Outside: Fire from Overheated Power Seat Motors
defect_summary: Hyundai Motor America (Genesis) is recalling certain 2015-2016 Hyundai Genesis, and 2017-2020 Genesis G80 vehicles. The front power seat motors may overheat due to a stuck power seat control switch, which can result in a fire while parked or driving.
consequence_summary: A fire increases the risk of injury.
corrective_action: Owners are advised to park their vehicles outdoors and away from other vehicles or structures until the repair has been performed. The remedy is currently under development. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 7, 2026. Owners of Hyundai vehicles may contact Hyundai customer service at 1-855-371-9460. Genesis owners may contact Genesis customer service at 844-340-9741. Hyundai recall number for this recall is 308 and Genesis' recall number is 035G. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning October 13, 2026.

subject: Tire Repair Kit Bottle Cap May Detach
defect_summary: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2023-2026 CR-V Hybrid, Accord Hybrid, and 2025 CR-V Fuel Cell EV vehicles that were previously remedied under NHTSA recall number 26V366. When using the tire repair kit, pressure may build within the sealant bottle, causing the bottle cap to detach.
consequence_summary: A detached bottle cap can become a projectile and strike the user or others nearby, increasing the risk of injury.
corrective_action: Dealers will inspect and replace the tire repair kit nozzle, as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 16, 2026. Owners may contact Honda's customer service at 1-866-784-1870. Honda's number for this recall is PPW. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will be searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning October 17, 2026. Vehicles previously repaired under recall 26V366 will need to have the new remedy completed.

subject: Fuel Filter Hoses May Disconnect and Leak Fuel
defect_summary: Tiffin Motorhomes, Inc. (Tiffin) is recalling certain 2022-2025 Allegro Bus, and Phaeton motorhomes, equipped with certain L9 diesel engines, part number D563027BX03. The remote fuel filter hoses may separate from the fitting, causing a fuel leak and an engine stall.
consequence_summary: A fuel leak in the presence of an ignition source increases the risk of a fire. An engine stall increases the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Cummins dealers will replace the fuel hoses, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 20, 2026. Owners may contact Tiffin customer service at 1-256-356-8661. Tiffin's number for this recall is TIF-150

subject: Fuel Filter Hoses May Disconnect and Leak Fuel
defect_summary: Sutphen Corporation (Sutphen) is recalling certain 2021 fire trucks equipped with Cummins L9 diesel engines with part number D563027BX03. The remote fuel filter hoses may separate from the fitting, causing a fuel leak and an engine stall.
consequence_summary: A fuel leak in the presence of an ignition source increases the risk of a fire. An engine stall increases the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Cummins dealers will replace the fuel hoses, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 7, 2026. Owners may contact Cummins customer service at 1-800-286-6467 or Sutphen's customer service at 1-614-889-1005. Cummins number for this recall is C7311.

subject: Fuel Filter Hoses May Disconnect and Leak Fuel
defect_summary: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2022-2025 Freightliner Business Class M2, 2022-2027 FCCC XCM, FCCC XCR, 2023 Freightliner 108SD, 2024-2027 FCCC XCS and FCCC XBS vehicles equipped with certain Cummins L9 diesel engines. The remote fuel filter hoses may separate from the fitting, causing a fuel leak and an engine stall.
consequence_summary: A fuel leak in the presence of an ignition source increases the risk of a fire. An engine stall increases the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Cummins will replace the fuel hoses, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 20, 2026. Owners may contact DTNA customer service at 1-800-547-0712 or Cummins customer service at 1-800-286-6467. DTNA's number for this recall is F1042.

subject: Motor Generator ECU Error May Cause Loss of Drive Power
defect_summary: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2026 RAV4 Plug-In Hybrid vehicles. The motor generator ECU may encounter an error, causing the plug-in-hybrid system to reduce power or shutdown when driven at higher speeds.
consequence_summary: An unexpected powertrain shutdown can cause a loss of drive power, increasing the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Dealers will update the ECU software, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed starting November 22, 2026. Owners may contact Toyota's customer service at 1-800-331-4331. Toyota's number for this recall is 26TA22.

subject: Reverse Gear Control Unit May Overheat
defect_summary: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2021-2024 R 18 motorcycles equipped with the optional reverse gear. The seal for the reverse gear control unit may deteriorate and allow moisture inside the control unit, which can result in the unit overheating.
consequence_summary: An overheated reverse gear control unit increases the risk of a fire.
corrective_action: Dealers will replace the reverse gear control unit, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 27, 2026. Owners may contact BMW customer service at 1-800-525-7417. Motorcycles in this recall were previously recalled under 24V716. Motorcycles previously repaired under the prior recall will need the new repair completed.

subject: Exterior Warning Lights May Fail To Illuminate
defect_summary: Kovatch Mobile Equipment Corp. (KME) is recalling certain 2024 CV515 SFA 4x4 and Severe Service emergency vehicles.  A node may become unresponsive and cause a loss of functionality of connected components, such as exterior lighting and pump-mode.
consequence_summary: A loss of exterior lights can reduce the visibility of the vehicle to other drivers, increasing the risk of a crash. A loss of pump-mode function may prevent or delay the use of emergency equipment, increasing the risk of injury.
corrective_action: KME will work with Fire Research Corporation to replace the node, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 1, 2026. Owners may contact KME customer service at 1-800-235-3928.

subject: Do Not Tow: Incorrect Plate in Coupler May Cause Trailer to Detach
defect_summary: Great Dane Trailers (Great Dane) is recalling certain 2027 Champion dry van trailers. The upper coupler may have an incorrect bottom plate installed. The kingpin may protrude, preventing the trailer from coupling properly.
consequence_summary: An improperly coupled trailer may detach, increasing the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Owners are advised not to use their trailers until the repair is completed. Great Dane will inspect and replace the upper coupler assembly as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 4, 2026. Owners may contact Great Dane's customer service at 1-877-369-3493.

subject: Front Row Seats Improperly Secured
defect_summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2025-2027 F-150 vehicles. The front seats may have been improperly secured to the vehicle.
consequence_summary: An improperly secured seat may not adequately restrain the seat occupant, increasing the risk of injury during a crash.
corrective_action: Dealers will inspect and tighten, or replace the front seat bolts as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed October 16, 2026. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332. Ford's number for this recall is 26S74. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on October 9, 2026.

subject: Exterior Lights May Fail To Illuminate
defect_summary: Spartan Fire, LLC (Spartan) is recalling one 2024 Metrostar emergency vehicle. A node may become unresponsive and cause a loss of functionality of connected components, such as exterior lighting and pump-mode.
consequence_summary: A loss of exterior lights can reduce the visibility of the vehicle to other drivers, increasing the risk of a crash. A loss of pump-mode function may prevent or delay the use of emergency equipment, increasing the risk of injury.
corrective_action: Spartan Fire will work with Fire Research Corporation to replace the I/O Nodes, free of charge. The owner notification letter is expected to be mailed November 1, 2026. Owners may contact Spartan customer service at 1-517-543-6400. Spartan's number for this recall is 26017.

subject: Inaccurate Speedometer and Tachometer Display/FMVSS 101
defect_summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2025-2026 F-250 SD, F-350 SD, F-450 SD, F-550 SD, F-600, 2026 F-150, and F-750 SD vehicles. The analog cluster’s tachometer and speedometer may become stuck or move erratically, providing inaccurate readings to the driver. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) Number 101, "Controls and Displays."
consequence_summary: A speedometer that fails to display accurate vehicle speed can increase the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Dealers will replace the instrument cluster modules, free of charge. Interim letters, notifying owners of the safety risk, are expected to be mailed in October 26, 2026. Additional letters will be sent once the remedy is available, anticipated in December 2026. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332. Ford's number for this recall is 26C46. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on October 7, 2026.

subject: Wire Harness and Busbar May Overheat
defect_summary: E-One Incorporated (E-One) is recalling certain 2024-2026 Typhoon N, 2025-2026 Cyclone N, and 2026 Cyclone II fire trucks. The positive power supply may be loose, causing the wiring harness and busbar to overheat.
consequence_summary: An overheated busbar can increase the risk of a fire.
corrective_action: E-ONE will provide a replacement wiring harness and busbar, free of charge.  Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed October 20, 2026. Owners may contact E-One customer service at 1-352-237-1122.

subject: Loss of Electronic Stability Control/FMVSS 126
defect_summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2026 Ram 2500 Pickup trucks. The trucks may be equipped with steering column control modules that can cause a loss of electronic stability control. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 126, "Electronic Stability Control Systems."
consequence_summary: A loss of electronic stability control increases the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Dealers will replace the steering column control module, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 24, 2026. Owners may contact FCA customer service at 1-800-853-1403. FCA's number for this recall is 90D. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on October 13, 2026. This recall expands previous NHTSA recall number 26V244.

subject: Blank or Distorted Rearview Camera Image
defect_summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2015 Transit Connect vehicles that were previously remedied under NHTSA recall number 25V572. The rearview camera may display a distorted, inverted, intermittent, or blank image when the vehicle is in reverse.
consequence_summary: A rearview camera that displays an inverted, distorted, intermittent, or blank image can reduce the driver’s view behind the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Dealers will replace the rearview camera as necessary, free of charge. Interim letters, notifying owners of the safety risk, were mailed in October 14, 2026. Additional letters will be sent once the remedy is available, anticipated in December 2027. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332. Ford's number for this recall is 26S73. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on October 7, 2026.

subject: Warning Lights May Fail To Illuminate
defect_summary: REV Ambulance Group Orlando, Inc. (REVO) is recalling certain 2025-2027 Road Rescue Type I, Road Rescue Type III, and 2025-2026 Wheeled Coach Type III ambulances. A node may become unresponsive and cause a loss of functionality of connected components, such as vehicle warning lights.
consequence_summary: A loss of warning lights can increase the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: REVO will provide a replacement S-Node 8x16 (Node 5), free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed in October 2026. Owners may contact REVO customer service at 1-855-661-9232.

subject: Park Outside: Printed Circuit Board May Short Circuit and Cause Fire
defect_summary: Kalmar Solutions, LLC (Kalmar) is recalling certain 2014-2026 Ottawa T2 4X2 and 2016-2026 T2 6X4 DOT/EPA terminal tractors. The printed circuit board (PCB) insulation may become damaged, resulting in a short circuit.
consequence_summary: A short circuit increases the risk of a fire even when the vehicle is parked and the ignition is in the 'Off' position.
corrective_action: Owners are advised to park outside and away from structures until their vehicle is repaired. Kalmar will rewire the cabin power and add a 5A fuse to the PCB circuit, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed by December 4, 2026. Owners may contact Kalmar customer service at 1-888-229-6300, select option 4, then option 2.

subject: Exterior Outlet May Lack GFCI Protection
defect_summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2027 Surveyor recreational trailers. The exterior receptacle may not be wired to a GFCI circuit.
consequence_summary: An outlet without GFCI protection may fail to shut off electrical power when a ground-fault occurs, increasing the risk of injury.
corrective_action: Dealers will rewire the exterior outlet, free of charge. Owners may contact Forest River customer service at 1-574-642-3119. Forest River's number for this recall is 37-2103.

subject: Incorrect Tire Inflation on Federal Placard
defect_summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2026-2027 Sunseeker, Solera, and Forester recreational vehicles. The Federal Placard may have incorrect tire inflation listed.
consequence_summary: A tire can be overinflated after referencing the incorrect information, increasing the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Dealers will replace the labels, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 4, 2026. Owners may contact Forest River customer service at 1-574-206-7600. Forest River's number for this recall is 34-2102.

subject: Hazard Indicator Light Not Displayed on Instrument Panel/FMVSS 108
defect_summary: Motor Coach Industries (MCI) is recalling certain 2018-2026 buses. Please see the complete list of models above. The instrument panel indicator light may not illuminate when the hazard warning lights are on and the master run switch is in the 'Off' position. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."
consequence_summary: Without the illuminated reminder, the driver may fail to turn off the exterior lights when no longer needed. Hazard warning lights that remain activated unintentionally can confuse other drivers, increasing the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: MCI will update the software, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 24, 2026. Owners may contact MCI customer service at 1-800-241-2947.

subject: Hazard Indicator Light Not Displayed on Instrument Panel/FMVSS 108
defect_summary: New Flyer of America, Inc. (New Flyer) is recalling certain 2013-2027 buses. Please see the complete list of models above. The instrument panel indicator light may not illuminate when the hazard warning lights are on and the master run switch is in the 'Off' position. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."
consequence_summary: Without the illuminated reminder, the driver may fail to turn off the exterior lights when no longer needed. Hazard warning lights that remain activated unintentionally can confuse other drivers, increasing the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: New Flyer will update the software, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 20, 2026. Owners may contact New Flyer's customer service at 1-800-241-2947.

subject: Bus May Move with Wheelchair Lift Deployed
defect_summary: Greenpower Motor Company Inc. (Greenpower) is recalling certain 2021 Nano Beast school buses. A control module interlock software error may allow the bus to move while the wheelchair lift is deployed.
consequence_summary: The bus moving while the wheelchair lift is in use increases the risk of injury.
corrective_action: Dealers will update the control module software, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed October 12, 2026. Owners may contact Greenpower's customer service at 1-909-346-1090. Greenpower's number for this recall is GP2604002.

subject: High Voltage Battery Mounting Bolts May Be Loose or Missing
defect_summary: Blue Bird Body Company (Blue Bird) is recalling certain 2022-2024 All American Electric transit buses. The high voltage battery system mounting bolts may be loose or missing.
consequence_summary: A high voltage battery with loose or missing mounting bolts can cause a loss of drive power, increasing the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Dealers will inspect and reinstall bolts with thread locker. Damaged or missing bolts will be replaced. All repairs will be performed free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 1, 2026. Owners may contact Blue Bird customer service at 1-478-822-2242. Blue Bird's number for this recall is R26AK.

subject: High Voltage Battery Mounting Bolts May Be Loose or Missing
defect_summary: Blue Bird Body Company (Blue Bird) is recalling certain 2018-2024, 2026 Vision and All American Electric school buses. The high voltage battery system mounting bolts may be loose or missing.
consequence_summary: A high voltage battery with loose or missing mounting bolts can cause a loss of drive power, increasing the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Dealers will inspect and reinstall bolts with thread locker. Damaged or missing bolts will be replaced. All repairs will be performed free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 1, 2026. Owners may contact Blue Bird customer service at 1-478-822-2242. Blue Bird's number for this recall is R26AK.

subject: Do Not Drive: Cracked Weld May Cause Wheel and/or Tire Failure
defect_summary: Rosenbauer America (Rosenbauer) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Commander and 2024 Warrior fire engines. The rim weld may crack, causing the wheel to separate and tire to deflate.
consequence_summary: Wheel and/or tire failure increases the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Owners are advised not to drive their vehicles until the remedy has been completed. Dealers will replace the wheels and tires as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed October 19, 2026. Owners may contact Rosenbauer customer service at 1-651-462-1000.

subject: Rear Bumper Hitch Plate May Bend
defect_summary: Ring Power Corporation (Ring Power) is recalling certain 2020 Terex General 65, 2020-2021 C6000, 2020-2022 C4000, and TC55 vehicles. The incorrect pintle hitch may have been installed without reinforced bracing, resulting in the rear bumper hitch plate bending.
consequence_summary: The pintle hitch may fail, causing a loss of trailer control and increasing the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Ring Power will inspect, replace the pintle hitch, and install bracing. Damaged bumpers will be replaced. All repairs will be performed free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed October 16, 2026. Owners may contact Ring Power's customer service at 904-613-0035. Ring Power's number for this recall is 23402.

subject: Front Brake Hose May Leak
defect_summary: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2022-2025 S 500 4MATIC, Maybach S 580 4MATIC, Maybach S 680 4MATIC,  S 580 4MATIC, 2023-2025 S 580 E 4MATIC, and 2024-2025 AMG S 63 E Performance vehicles. The front brake hoses may rupture and leak brake fluid.
consequence_summary: A brake fluid leak can extend the distance needed to stop the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Dealers will replace the front brake hoses, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 27, 2026. Owners may contact MBUSA customer service at 1-800-367-6372. This recall expands previous NHTSA recall number 25V116. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on October 9, 2026.

subject: Platform Access Step May Separate from Vehicle
defect_summary: Altec Industries, Inc. (Altec) is recalling certain 2020-2026 AA Series Aerial Device, 2021-2026 AN Series Aerial Device, 2023-2026 AM Series Aerial Device, and 2024-2026 Digger Derrick, and 2024-2025 A-Class vehicles. The turntable mounted platform access step may have been improperly welded between the step tube and mounting plate, and allow the step to separate from the vehicle.
consequence_summary: A step that separates or becomes unstable while in use, increases the risk of a fall or injury.
corrective_action: Altec will replace the steps, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 27, 2026. Owners may contact Altec's customer service at 1-877-462-5832. Altec's number for this recall is CSN-3374.

subject: Improperly Installed Seat Belt Component
defect_summary: Mercedes-Benz is recalling certain 2027 CLA 220 vehicles. A component of the left front seat belt may have been installed incorrectly.
consequence_summary: A seat belt with an incorrectly installed component may fail to properly restrain occupants, increasing the risk of injury during a crash.
corrective_action: Dealers will inspect and replace the seat belt as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 27, 2026. Owners may contact MBUSA customer service at 1-800-367-6372.

subject: Insulation May Catch Fire
defect_summary: Daimler Trucks North America (DTNA) is recalling certain 2025-2027 Freightliner Business Class M2 vehicles. The underbody insulation may contact hot exhaust components.
consequence_summary: Insulation that comes into contact with hot exhaust components increases the risk of a fire.
corrective_action: The remedy is currently under development. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 30, 2026. Owners may contact DTNA customer service at 1-800-547-0712. DTNA's number for this recall is F1041.

subject: Fuel Pump May Fail
defect_summary: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2023-2025 VT1300CX and 2024-2025 VT750 motorcycles. The fuel pump may malfunction due to a manufacturing defect.
consequence_summary: Fuel pump failure can cause an engine stall, increasing the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Dealers will replace the fuel pump, free of charge.  Interim letters notifying owners of the safety risk are expected to be mailed November 27, 2026. Additional letters will be sent once the final remedy is available, anticipated in January 2027. Owners may contact Honda's customer service at 1-866-784-1870. Honda's numbers for this recall are KU9, KV0, and KV1. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will be searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning October 8, 2026.

subject: Insufficient Illumination from Low Beam Headlights
defect_summary: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2027 Thomas Built SAF-T-LINER C2 and Thomas Built SAF-T-LINER C2 Jouley school buses. A software error may cause the low beam headlights to illuminate improperly.
consequence_summary: Insufficient low beam headlight illumination can reduce driver visibility, increasing the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Dealers will inspect and replace the headlights, as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 30, 2026. Owners may contact DTNA customer service at 1-800-547-0712. DTNA's number for this recall is F1040.

subject: Intake and Grille Bezels May Detach
defect_summary: Mack Trucks, Inc. (Mack) is recalling certain 2026-2027 Anthem AN (4) and 2025-2027 Pioneer PR (4) vehicles. The intake and grille bezels may detach from the vehicle.
consequence_summary: A detached bezel can become a road hazard for other vehicles, increasing the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Dealers will inspect, replace the intake and grille bezels, and install cable ties as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 30, 2026. Owners may contact Mack's customer service at 1-800-866-1177. Mack's number for this recall is SC0501. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will become searchable on NHTSA.gov on October 8, 2026.

subject: High Voltage Battery May Catch Fire
defect_summary: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Volkswagen) is recalling certain 2023-2026 ID.4 vehicles. The high voltage battery may fail and lead to a vehicle fire.
consequence_summary: A vehicle fire increases the risk of injury.
corrective_action: Owners are advised to only charge their vehicles to a maximum of 80% battery capacity until the repair has been completed. The remedy is currently under development. Interim letters, notifying owners of the safety risk, are expected to be mailed November 27, 2026. Additional letters will be sent once the remedy is available. Owners may contact Volkswagen customer service at 1-800-893-5298. Volkswagen's number for this recall is 93EX. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on October 6, 2026.

subject: Bus May Move with Wheelchair Lift Deployed
defect_summary: Greenpower Motor Company Inc. (Greenpower) is recalling certain 2018-2024 EV Star and 2020-2023 EV Star Mobility Plus buses. A control module interlock software error may allow the bus to move while the wheelchair lift is deployed.
consequence_summary: The bus moving while the wheelchair lift is in use increases the risk of injury.
corrective_action: Dealers will update the control module software, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed October 12, 2026. Owners may contact Greenpower's customer service at 1-909-346-1090. Greenpower's number for this recall is GP2604002.

subject: Printed Circuit Board May Overheat
defect_summary: Grech Motors Inc. (Grech) is recalling certain 2027 Strada, Terreno, and 2026-2027 Turismo motorhomes equipped with certain MaxxAir N-Series Maxxfan rooftop ventilation fans. The printed circuit board may fail during certain operations and overheat.
consequence_summary: An overheated printed circuit board increases the risk of a fire.
corrective_action: Dealers will inspect and replace the printed circuit board as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed October 30, 2026. Owners may contact Grech Customer service at 1-951-688-8347.

subject: Fresh Water Tank May Detach
defect_summary: Highland Ridge RV (Highland Ridge) is recalling certain 2022-2024 Range Lite Air travel trailers. The fasteners may fail, causing the fresh water tank to detach.
consequence_summary: A detached tank can become a road hazard for other vehicles, increasing the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Dealers will redrill holes and install new screws and bolts, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed October 6, 2026. Owners may contact Highland Ridge customer service at 1-800-283-8267. Highland Ridge's number for this recall is 9904669.

subject: Fresh Water Tank May Detach
defect_summary: Starcraft RV (Starcraft) is recalling certain 2022-2024 Super Lite Maxx travel trailers. The fasteners may fail, causing the fresh water tank to detach.
consequence_summary: A detached tank can become a road hazard for other vehicles, increasing the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Dealers will redrill holes and install new screws and bolts, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed October 6, 2026. Owners may contact Starcraft customer service at 1-800-283-8267. Starcraft's number for this recall is 9902669.

subject: Improperly Tightened High Voltage Fastener May Cause a Loss of Drive Power
defect_summary: Rivian Automotive, LLC (Rivian) is recalling certain 2027 R2 vehicles. A high voltage battery fastener may have been improperly tightened, causing a loss of drive power.
consequence_summary: A loss of drive power increases the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Rivian will inspect and repair the connection or replace damaged components as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 28, 2026. Owners may contact Rivian customer service at 1-888-748-4261. Rivian's number for this recall is FSAM-1888. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will become searchable on NHTSA.gov on November 28, 2026.

subject: Bike Rack May Detach
defect_summary: Nova Bus (US) Inc. (Nova Bus) is recalling certain 2022-2023 LFS transit buses. The mounting screws may be too short, stripping the threads and causing the bike rack to detach.
consequence_summary: A detached bike rack can become a road hazard for other vehicles, increasing the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Nova Bus will replace the mounting screws, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 28, 2026. Owners may contact Nova Bus customer service at 1-800-350-6682. Nova Bus's number for this recall is CR5957.

subject: Tire Pressure Monitor System May Fail/FMVSS 138
defect_summary: Chrysler (FCA US LLC) is recalling certain 2026 Ram 1500 vehicles. The tire pressure monitoring system sensors may fail to detect low tire pressure and/or fail to illuminate the tire pressure monitoring system (TPMS) warning light as intended. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 138, "Tire Pressure Monitoring System."
consequence_summary: A TPMS warning light that fails to notify the driver of low tire pressure increases the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Dealers will inspect and replace the tire pressure sensors, as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed October 27, 2026. Owners may contact FCA US, LLC customer service at 1-800-853-1403. FCA US, LLC's number for this recall is 51D. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on October 6, 2026.

subject: Driver & Front Passenger Side Air Bags May Not Deploy/FMVSS 208 & 214
defect_summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2026 Ram 1500 vehicles. A connector for the driver and front passenger side air bags may not be secured properly, which can cause the air bags not to deploy as intended. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 208, "Occupant Crash Protection" and 214, "Side Impact Protection."
consequence_summary: A side air bag that does not deploy as intended increases the risk of injury in a crash.
corrective_action: Dealers will inspect and repair the sensor connections, as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed October 27, 2026. Owners may contact Chrysler customer service at 800-853-1403. Chrysler's number for this recall is 94D. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on October 6, 2026.

subject: Loss of Power Steering Assist
defect_summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain MOPAR body and jumper wiring harnesses. Please refer to Chrysler's attached document for specific part number information. Water may enter the electric power steering wiring harness, which can disable power steering assist.
consequence_summary: A loss of power steering assist can increase the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Dealers will inspect and replace the wiring harness and electronic power steering gear, as necessary, free of charge. Dealers will repurchase uninstalled wiring harnesses. Interim notification letters, notifying owners of the safety risk, are expected to be mailed November 17, 2026. Additional letters will be sent once the final remedy is available. Owners may contact Chrysler customer service at 800-853-1403. Chrysler's number for this recall is 93D.

subject: Loss of Power Steering Assist
defect_summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2022-2026 Ram 1500 Promaster, Ram 2500 Promaster, Ram 3500 Promaster, and 2024-2026 Ram 3500 Electric (EV) vehicles. Water may enter the electric power steering wiring harness, which can disable power steering assist.
consequence_summary: A loss of power steering assist can increase the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Dealers will inspect and replace the wiring harness and electronic power steering gear, as necessary, free of charge. Interim notification letters, notifying owners of the safety risk, are expected to be mailed November 17, 2026. Additional letters will be sent once the final remedy is available. Owners may contact Chrysler customer service at 800-853-1403. Chrysler's number for this recall is 92D. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will became searchable on NHTSA.gov on October 6, 2026.

subject: Fuel Filter Hoses May Disconnect and Leak Fuel
defect_summary: Cummins, Inc. (Cummins) is recalling certain L9 diesel engines, part number D563027BX03. The remote fuel filter hoses may separate from the fitting, causing a fuel leak and an engine stall.
consequence_summary: A fuel leak in the presence of an ignition source increases the risk of a fire. An engine stall increases the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Dealers will replace the fuel hoses, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 20, 2026. Owners may contact Cummins customer service at 1-800-286-6467. Cummins number for this recall is C7311. Engines remedied under Recalls 23E055, 24E038, or 25E004 will need to have the new redesigned parts installed.

subject: Software Calculation Error May Cause Reduced Braking Performance
defect_summary: Mack Trucks, Inc. (Mack) is recalling certain 2026-2027 Anthem AN (4) and Pioneer PR (4) vehicles equipped with a tanker application package. Inaccurate axle load calculations may cause reduced braking performance while transporting smoothbore tanker trailers.
consequence_summary: Reduced braking performance can require a greater distance to stop, increasing the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Dealers will install new software to disable the dynamic trailer braking calculations, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 27, 2026. Owners may contact Mack's customer service at 1-800-866-1177. Mack's number for this recall is SC0500. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will become searchable on NHTSA.gov on October 5, 2026.

subject: Software Calculation Error May Cause Reduced Braking Performance
defect_summary: Volvo Trucks North America (Volvo Trucks) is recalling certain 2025-2027 VNL (4) and 2026-2027 VNR (4) vehicles equipped with a tanker application package. Inaccurate axle load calculations may cause reduced braking performance while transporting smoothbore tanker trailers.
consequence_summary: Reduced braking performance can require a greater distance to stop, increasing the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Dealers will install new software to disable the dynamic trailer braking calculations, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 27, 2026. Owners may contact Volvo Trucks' customer service at 800-528-6586. Volvo Trucks' number for this recall is RVXX2610. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will become searchable on NHTSA.gov on October 5, 2026.

subject: Coupler May Separate from Trailer
defect_summary: Aluminum Trailer Company (ATC) is recalling certain 2024-2026 RM900 and 2026 RM700 trailers. The coupler mounting bolts may loosen, separating the coupler from the trailer.
consequence_summary: A separated trailer coupler can cause a loss of control and increase the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: ATC will install a gusset reinforcement kit, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed October 13, 2026. Owners may call ATC customer service at 1-877-441-2440.

subject: Boom Stow Auto-Neutral System Improperly Wired
defect_summary: Altec Industries, Inc. (Altec) is recalling certain 2021-2026 Altec Digger Derrick, and 2023-2025 Altec TA Series Aerial Device vehicles. Improper wiring may prevent the boom stow auto-neutral feature from engaging, which can allow the truck to be driven while the boom is still elevated.
consequence_summary: When the vehicle is moved or driven with the boom out of stow, the vehicle could exceed the recorded travel height, increasing the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Altec will correct the wiring in the power distribution module to enable the boom stow auto-neutral functionality, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 20, 2026. Owners may contact Altec's customer service at 1-877-462-5832. Altec's number for this recall is CSN-3370.

subject: Solar Controller May Select Incorrect Voltage Output
defect_summary: Grand Design RV, LLC (Grand Design) is recalling certain 2024-2027 Reflection fifth wheel recreational trailers. The auto detect solar controller may select a 24 volt output when the electrical system is designed for 12 volts. The incorrect voltage may damage the 7-way bulkhead power center and other circuits.
consequence_summary: While damage to the power center increases the risk of a fire, damage to the electrical system may cause the trailer brakes or exterior lightings to fail, increasing the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: An over-the-air (OTA) software update will be released. Lighting will be inspected and repaired as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 16, 2026. Owners may contact Grand Design customer service at 1-574-825-9679. Grand Design's number for this recall is 910068.

subject: Window Automatic Reversal System Malfunction/FMVSS 118
defect_summary: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2025-2027 Cadillac OPTIQ vehicles. When closed using the key fob's express-up function, the front windows may fail to detect an obstruction and reverse direction. As such, these vehicles fail to conform to Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 118, "Power-Operated Window Systems."
consequence_summary: A closing window that does not reverse direction as expected can pinch a passenger before retracting, increasing the risk of injury.
corrective_action: The body control module (BCM) software will be updated by a dealer or through an over-the-air (OTA) update, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 9, 2026. Owners may contact Cadillac customer service at 1-800-458-8006. GM's number for this recall is N262567230. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on September 24, 2026.

manufacturer: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC
subject: Seat Belt May Be Improperly Stitched
defect_summary: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC (Land Rover) is recalling certain 2024 Land Rover Defender vehicles. The second-row seat belt may be improperly stitched.
consequence_summary: An improperly stitched seat belt may fail to properly restrain an occupant during a crash, increasing the risk of injury.
corrective_action: Dealers will inspect the second-row seat belt serial number, and replace the seat belt, as necessary, free of charge. Interim letters notifying owners of the safety risk are expected to be mailed November 20, 2026. Additional letters will be sent once the final remedy is available. Owners may contact Land Rover's customer service at 800-637-6837. Land Rover's number for this recall is D130.

manufacturer: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC
subject: Rear Subframe May Crack
defect_summary: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC (Land Rover) is recalling certain 2024-2026 Range Rover Sport vehicles. Cracks may develop in the rear subframe.
consequence_summary: A cracked subframe may have reduced structural integrity, increasing the risk of injury during a crash. A crack may also diminish handling and control, increasing the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Dealers will inspect and replace the rear subframe as necessary, free of charge. Interim letters notifying owners of the safety risk are expected to be mailed November 20, 2026. Additional letters will be sent once the final remedy is available. Owners may contact Land Rover customer service at 1-800-637-6837. Land Rover's numbers for this recall are D165 and D166.

subject: Air Bag Inflator Endcap May Detach
defect_summary: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2016 Chevrolet Silverado 2500/3500, GMC Sierra 2500/3500 vehicles, and 2016-2017 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 and GMC Sierra 1500 vehicles. The left-side or right-side roof rail air bag (RRAB) inflator end cap may detach from the inflator or the inflator sidewall may rupture.
consequence_summary: A detached end cap or inflator rupture can allow compressed gas to escape and project the end cap or fragments of the inflator into the vehicle, increasing the risk of injury.
corrective_action: Dealers will replace both RRAB modules, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 9, 2026. Owners may contact GMC customer service at 1-888-988-7267 or Chevrolet customer service at 1-800-222-1020. GM's number for this recall is N262569920. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on September 24, 2026.

subject: Misaligned Bunk Mat may be Unsupported
defect_summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2026-2027 Dynamax Isata recreational vehicles. The bunk mat may not be properly aligned.
consequence_summary: A misaligned mat may not be supported, resulting in an occupant falling from the bunk and increasing the risk of injury.
corrective_action: Dealers will install a spacer to align the bunk mat, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 2, 2026. Owners may contact Forest River customer service at 1-574-206-7600. Forest River's number for this recall is 55-2100.

subject: Bunk Ladder May Come Loose
defect_summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2026-2027 Dynamax Isata recreational vehicles. The bunk ladder may be attached to a wooden mattress insert, resulting in the ladder loosening.
consequence_summary: A ladder that pulls away from the bunk increases the risk of injury.
corrective_action: Dealers will replace the mattress insert with a metal frame, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed October 23, 2026. Owners may contact Forest River customer service at 1-574-206-7600. Forest River's number for this recall is 55-2099.

subject: Sleeper Sofa May Block Bunkroom Door
defect_summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Cedar Creek fifth wheel recreational trailers. The sleeper sofa may block the bunkroom door.
consequence_summary: A blocked door can prevent or delay occupants from exiting during an emergency, increasing their risk of injury.
corrective_action: Dealers will correct the swing of the bunkroom door, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed October 19, 2026. Owners may contact Forest River customer service at 1-574-825-4995. Forest River's number for this recall is 20-2098.

manufacturer: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC
subject: Powertrain Control Module May Cause a Loss of Drive Power
defect_summary: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC (Land Rover) is recalling one 2026 Range Rover Sport vehicle. The circuit board in the powertrain control module (PCM) was misaligned during production and may be deformed.
consequence_summary: A deformed circuit board may cause a loss of drive power, increases the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: A dealer will replace the PCM, free of charge. An interim letter notifying the owner of the safety risk is expected to be mailed November 20, 2026. An additional letter will be sent once the final remedy is available. Owners may contact Land Rover's customer service at 800-637-6837. Land Rover's number for this recall is D164.

subject: Exterior Lighting May Fail/FMVSS 108
defect_summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2025-2027 Expedition, 2026 F-250 SD, F-350 SD, F-450 SD, and F-550 SD vehicles. The headlight assemblies may contain a contaminated LED chip, which can result in a loss of daytime running lights, parking lights, high beams or low beams. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."
consequence_summary: A loss of exterior lighting can reduce visibility, increasing the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Dealers will inspect and replace the headlight assemblies, as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed October 26, 2026. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332. Ford's number for this recall is 26C43. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will be searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning October 26, 2026.

subject: Rearview Camera Image May Not Display/FMVSS 111
defect_summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 10.1-inch center stack screens installed in 2024-2026 Ranger vehicles during service. The screen may lose power and fail to display the rearview camera image. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 111, "Rear Visibility."
consequence_summary: A rearview camera image that does not display reduces the driver's view behind the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: The remedy is currently under development. Interim letters notifying owners of the safety risk were mailed October 7, 2026. Additional letters will be sent when the remedy is available. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332. Ford's number for this recall is 26C42. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on September 25, 2026.

subject: Rearview Camera Image May Not Display/FMVSS 111
defect_summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2026 Ranger vehicles equipped with a 10.1-inch center stack screen. The screen may lose power and fail to display the rearview camera image. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 111, "Rear Visibility."
consequence_summary: A rearview camera image that does not display reduces the driver's view behind the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: The remedy is currently under development. Interim letters notifying owners of the safety risk were mailed October 7, 2026.
